title: Self-similar imploding solutions of the 1D compressible Euler equations with a far field cutoff
summary: Imploding solutions to the radially symmetric, isentropic, compressible Euler equations have been well-studied, inspired by the work of Guderley. However, these smooth imploding solutions are shown to be numerically unstable and difficult to compute in practice. On the other hand, the imploding solution of Kidder has a closed form solution and is numerically computable. But, it is unbounded in the far field.
